scope: CAD X3-A saved construction source/element/branch reassignment

transient Review, exact before/after world coordinates, affected object impact and one Undo/Redo

self/indirect cycles, missing source/topology, wrong plane/elevation, no intersection and operation changes reject atomically
locked output/dependent construction/annotation reject; locked read-only source is allowed
save/reload checks construction caches, expression/query graph, finite artboard SVG export
native select draft, Cancel, stale review, document-change invalidation and locked selection gating
limitations: Operation and result kind conversion is excluded
